conclusion: The declared complete experiment does not reproduce TM01 tracking robustness or Table I success-rate advantage. Frequency changes occur but do not establish the claimed gain.
remaining_scientific_issue: Sampling sometimes fails before disturbances. Resolve the physics/model/low-level discrepancy before attributing it to the method. Table I duration and wrench schedule are not specified in the paper.
notes: Fixed author version method reproduction, not identical paper hardware/model.
All 150 random-wrench outcomes retained. Means are episode means over their actual durations.
The paper's 0.12/0.14/0.08 Mean Cost has no fully specified scalar definition; these metrics are explicitly defined.
